content.value: Consider water at $2 0 \%$ flowing at 6 m/s past a 1 m diameter circular cylinder. What doublet 08 strength is required to simulate this flow? If the freestream pressure is 200 kPa, use inviscid theory to estimate the surface pressure at (i) 135°, and (ii) 90°.
